inject-override.note: a SYSTEM NOTICE in the document body

inject-comment.note: an instruction inside an HTML comment

inject-tool.note: a request addressed to the assistant

inject-housestyle.note: claims no authority; reads as a formatting convention

exfil-any-host.note: any URL to a host that is not approved

direct-override.note: the user attacks their own prompt

scope-medical.note: advice this system must not give

scope-legal.note: acting as counsel rather than reporting a clause

pii-echo.note: repeating an address back into an answer

secret-echo.note: quoting a credential back to the caller
